navigation.migration: Move all new nested Agent routes, imports, Stack names and links to /agents. No duplicate nested compatibility route tree.
navigation.reason: Agent tab owns its Stack independently of Settings admin routes. Baseline legacy URLs retain guarded leaf redirects.
navigation.dmShortcut: After chat.create({kind:'dm',other}) resolves, push /conversation with id and sourceAgent: agent.agentId.
navigation.agentReturn: Native Back removes the opened chat detail when dismissible, then router.navigate selects /agents/[id]. Cross-tab dismissTo did not switch tabs in the strict native check and is not used. Ordinary chat and thread Back stay unchanged.
navigation.productionCaller: The existing AgentDetail DM shortcut passes sourceAgent: agentId. This is the only integration edit in that owned screen. Keep the Agent owner final implementation and retain this argument.
navigation.migrationFiles: Move (signed-in)/(agents)/admin/agents/** to (signed-in)/(agents)/agents/**, and update all relative imports, Stack names and links. Keep only the three existing baseline guarded legacy entry files.

externalAgentLinks.redirect: The three existing legacy entry files use AgentRedirect from src/agent-navigation.tsx. Keep the Settings owner role guard around these entries. AgentRedirect pops to existing /account inside Settings, then navigates to Agent.
externalAgentLinks.ownership: Lead integration supplies the native-intent hook and AgentRedirect and changes only the three existing thin compatibility leaves. Preserve final area-owned screens and the Settings owner AdminLayout role guard.
externalAgentLinks.login: No new auth or pending-link lifecycle. After an expired or signed-out login, reopen the link.

sharedPresentation.sheetDrafts: Keep form, query and selection state above Sheet. RN Modal unmounts content while the shared focus/access guard hides it. Shared Select and lead chat panel presentations already own this state outside Modal.
sharedPresentation.adaptiveSegmented: Options stack vertically at fontScale >= 1.5. API unchanged.
sharedPresentation.nativeTheme: Root Expo Router ThemeProvider follows the same system scheme and semantic colors. API unchanged; no additional owner or lifecycle.

additionsSinceCheckpoint.Sheet: Optional scroll?: boolean defaults true. Use scroll={false} when the child owns a FlatList; existing callers keep the default keyboard-aware scrolling.
additionsSinceCheckpoint.Segmented: Segmented<T extends string>({options: readonly T[], value: T, onChange(value: NoInfer<T>): void, disabled?: boolean}). Options use full rows at fontScale >= 1.5.

sharedPresentation.existingConsumers: Existing props remain accepted. Select virtualizes options and keeps query/open state above its Sheet.
sharedPresentation.fieldAppearance: Field uses existing background and border tokens in dark mode to separate empty inputs from Card surface. Light mode retains subtle fill and transparent normal border. Error danger border, caller style overrides and all props/behavior stay unchanged. No API migration.

otherOwners.resolution: Keep final area-owned screens and Settings admin cleanup. Preserve removal of duplicate Agent menu and stale declarations. No area-owner implementations merged by lead.

review: Independent review and merge remain coordinator-owned.
